name: Strike
description: Attack with your weapon. Builds Fury on a hit.

name: Power Attack
description: A ponderous blow with an extra weapon damage die (2 at level 10, 3 at 18). Counts as two attacks for the cadence penalty.

name: Sudden Charge
description: Dash up to 6 tiles to an enemy and Strike.

name: Cleave
description: A broad cut through the enemies in front of you: Strike your target and up to two more within reach and 60° of it. Only the first hit builds Fury.

name: Raise a Shield
description: Raise your shield for 6 s: its circumstance bonus to AC, and Shield Block takes its hardness off a blow (once every 6 s). Needs a shield in your off hand.

name: Finishing Blow
description: Pour all your Fury (at least 30) into one Strike: an extra weapon damage die for every 25 Fury spent. Joins the bar at level 2.

name: Ignition
description: Hurl a flame: a spell attack for 2d6 fire (+1d6 per rank above 1). A critical hit also sets the target burning.

name: Force Bolt
description: Two bolts of force that never miss, 1d4+1 force each (one more bolt every two ranks).

name: Staff Strike
description: Bash with your staff.

name: Shield
description: A cantrip ward of force for 6 s: +1 circumstance bonus to AC, and Shield Block takes 5 off a blow (+5 every two spell ranks). Once it blocks, the ward breaks and can't be cast again for 10 s.

name: Intimidating Strike
description: A blow meant to cow: on a hit the target is frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical hit).

name: Brutish Shove
description: Strike and shove: on a hit the target is knocked back 1.5 tiles and off-guard for 2 s.

name: Knockdown
description: Strike to bring them down: on a hit the target is knocked prone (off-guard, can't move) for 1.5 s.

name: Swipe
description: One whirling swing at every enemy within reach, all around you. Only the first hit builds Fury.

name: Electric Arc
description: A cantrip arc of lightning: 1d4 electricity (+1d4 per rank above 1) that leaps to a second enemy within 3 tiles.

name: Ray of Frost
description: A cantrip ray of cold: 2d4 cold (+1d4 per rank above 1); on a hit the target is slowed 1 for 2 s.

name: Alchemist's fire
description: A flask of sticky fire: 1d8 fire and 1 persistent fire on a hit (more every two levels), 1 fire splash around the target even on a miss.

name: Frost vial
description: A vial of biting cold: 1d6 cold on a hit (more every two levels) and slowed for 3 s, 1 cold splash around the target even on a miss.

name: Bottled lightning
description: A jar of crackling lightning: 1d6 electricity on a hit (more every two levels) and off-guard for 3 s, 1 electricity splash around the target even on a miss.

name: Acid flask
description: A flask of eating acid: 1 acid and 1d6 persistent acid on a hit (more every two levels), 1 acid splash around the target even on a miss.

name: Antidote
description: Ends any poison in you and gives +2 to saves against poison (the bog, the rot) for 2 minutes.

name: Earthshaker
description: Slam your two-handed weapon into the ground: every enemy within 2 tiles takes your weapon's damage against a basic Reflex save (your class DC), knocked back 1.5 tiles on a failure. 20 Fury, 5 s cooldown.

name: Challenge
description: Roar a challenge: every enemy within 5 tiles turns on you, and those that fail a Will save against your class DC are frightened 1 (2 on a critical failure). 10 Fury, 12 s cooldown.

name: Burning Hands
description: A 3-tile cone of flame toward your target: 2d6 fire (+1d6 a rank above 1) to every enemy in it, against a basic Reflex save (your spell DC). 14 Mana.

name: Thunderclap
description: Lightning cracks all round you: 2d4 electricity (+1d4 a rank above 1) to every enemy within 2.5 tiles against a basic Reflex save (your spell DC), knocked back a tile on a failure. 14 Mana, 3 s cooldown.

name: Strike
description: Attack with your weapon. Builds Momentum on a hit, more on a critical hit. With an agile or finesse weapon your sneak attack lands on any target off-guard to you: unaware of you, struck from hiding, prone or off-guard.

name: Sneak Strike
description: A feint and a quick thrust: the target is off-guard against this Strike (−2 AC), so your sneak attack lands. 20 Momentum.

name: Tumble
description: Roll up to 3.5 tiles toward the pointer, through enemies; nothing can hit you mid-roll. Like any movement it builds Momentum. 5 s cooldown.

name: Hide in Shadows
description: Slip into the shadows for 10 s. Monsters that haven't seen you notice you only once you are next to them; those hunting you from further than 2 tiles may lose you (your Stealth against their Perception). Your first blow out of hiding finds its target off-guard. You move at three-quarters speed, and attacking or being hit brings you out. 12 s cooldown.

name: Eviscerate
description: Pour all your Momentum (at least 30) into one Strike: an extra weapon damage die for every 20 spent. Joins the bar at level 2.

name: Gutting Strike
description: A Strike that opens a deep wound: on a hit, 1d6 persistent bleed (a die more at levels 5, 10 and 15). 15 Momentum.

name: Snare
description: Set a snare at your feet (two at most). Once armed, the first enemy to step on it sets it off: 2d6 piercing (+1d6 a rank above 1) to every enemy within 1.5 tiles against a basic Reflex save (your class DC), immobilized for 2 s on a failure. 15 Momentum, 3 s cooldown.

name: Twin Feint
description: Two quick Strikes, the second a feint: the target is off-guard against it, so your sneak attack lands. 15 Momentum.

name: Whirling Blades
description: Spin through the press: one Strike at every enemy within reach, all round you. Only the first hit builds Momentum. 25 Momentum.

name: Strike
description: Attack with your weapon: with a bow, an arrow at anything in range and in sight. Against your prey, Hunt Prey's precision die is added.

name: Twin Shot
description: Loose two arrows at once at your target, each a Strike. 10 Focus. Needs a bow.

name: Hunt Prey
description: Mark a monster you can see within 12 tiles as your prey: your Strikes against it deal 1d8 more precision damage (2d8 at level 11). It stays your prey until it dies or you hunt another.

name: Disengage
description: Spring up to 3 tiles toward the pointer, untouchable on the way: out of a melee and back into bow range. 6 s cooldown.

name: Aimed Shot
description: A careful Strike: one more weapon damage die (2 at level 10, 3 at 18). 15 Focus. Joins the bar at level 2.

name: Piercing Shot
description: An arrow driven clean through: one more weapon damage die, and it flies on through up to 3 enemies behind its target, a Strike at each. 15 Focus, 4 s cooldown. Needs a bow.

name: Sic 'Em
description: Send your wolf at a monster within 10 tiles: it bounds there and bites with one more damage die, knocking its target prone for 1.5 s on a hit. 10 Focus, 8 s cooldown.

name: Strike
description: Attack with your weapon. Builds a little Devotion on a hit; the blows you take build more.

name: Smite
description: A blow driven by your oath: one more weapon damage die (2 at level 10, 3 at 18). 10 Devotion.

name: Lay on Hands
description: Your hands mend wounds: you, and every ally within 3 tiles, heal 6 HP a spell rank. 30 Devotion, 10 s cooldown.

name: Shield of Faith
description: An aura of faith for 15 s: +1 status bonus to AC and saves, and every blow at you or an ally within 3 tiles loses 1 damage (one more every two spell ranks). A shield in your off hand is raised for as long: its AC, and Shield Block. 25 Devotion.

name: Lantern's Radiance
description: Holy light for 12 s: every 2 s each enemy within 2.5 tiles takes 1d4 (a die more every two spell ranks) against a basic Fortitude save, vitality to the undead and fire to the living, and you and your allies within heal 1 (one more every two ranks). 25 Devotion.

name: Aura of Dread
description: Your broken oath spills out for 12 s: every 2 s each enemy within 3 tiles takes 1d6 Taint (a die more every two spell ranks) against a basic Will save, frightened 1 on a failure (2 on a critical failure), and half of what it deals heals you. Paid with 20 of your Taint meter, not Devotion.

name: Grave Bolt
description: A cantrip bolt of grave-cold: a spell attack for 2d6 void (+1d6 per rank above 1).

name: Raise Bones
description: A skeleton claws its way out of the ground beside you and fights for you until it falls. You hold two (three from level 5); raising another makes the oldest crumble. Takes a Grave Charge if you have one, else 12 Mana.

name: Siphon Life
description: Draw the life out of an enemy: a spell attack for 1d8 void (+1d8 per rank above 1), and half the damage heals you. 10 Mana.

name: Bone Rush
description: Every skeleton you hold rushes a monster within 10 tiles, and its next blow deals one more die. A Grave Charge, 6 s cooldown. Joins the bar at level 2.

name: Bone Armor
description: Bones knit round you for 15 s: +1 circumstance bonus to AC, and Shield Block takes 4 off a blow (+2 every two spell ranks) once every 6 s. A Grave Charge.

name: Corpse Explosion
description: The grave's rot bursts round a monster within 8 tiles: 2d6 void (+1d6 a rank above 1) to every enemy within 2 tiles of it against a basic Fortitude save (your spell DC), sickened 1 for 4 s on a failure. A Grave Charge.

name: Intimidating Roar
description: A roar that breaks nerve: every enemy within 4 tiles that fails a Will save against your class DC is frightened 2 (3 on a critical failure), and turns on you. 15 Fury, 15 s cooldown. Joins the bar at level 6.

name: Retributive Strike
description: For 12 s your oath answers every blow: a monster that strikes you from within reach takes a Strike back at once (at most once a second). 20 Devotion. Joins the bar at level 6.

name: Shadowstep
description: Step through the shadows up to 6 tiles toward the pointer, untouchable, and come out of them hidden for 4 s. 15 Momentum, 10 s cooldown. Joins the bar at level 6.

name: Rain of Arrows
description: Arrows fall on a monster within 10 tiles and everything within 2.5 tiles of it: your bow's damage against a basic Reflex save (your class DC). 20 Focus, 6 s cooldown. Needs a bow. Joins the bar at level 6.

name: Blink
description: Vanish and reappear up to 5 tiles toward the pointer, untouchable for the moment between. 8 Mana, 8 s cooldown. Joins the bar at level 6.

name: Bone Spear
description: A spear of bone: a spell attack for 3d6 piercing (+1d6 a rank above 1) that flies on through two more enemies. A Grave Charge and 10 Mana. Joins the bar at level 6.

name: Whirlwind Strike
description: Vanguard, level 8: one great turning blow at every enemy in reach, a weapon die more. Two-handed only. 30 Fury, 6 s cooldown.

name: Shield Slam
description: Bulwark, level 8: drive your shield into them: a Strike with a weapon die more that knocks the target back 1.5 tiles and prone for 2 s. Needs a shield. 20 Fury, 8 s cooldown.

name: Beacon of Hope
description: Lanternbearer, level 8: the lantern blazes: you and your allies within 4 tiles heal 8 HP a spell rank, and 50 Taint burns out of you. 30 Devotion, 20 s cooldown.

name: Dread Harvest
description: Oathbreaker, level 8: reap the dread round a monster within 7 tiles: 2d6 Taint (+1d6 a rank above 1) to all within 3 tiles of it against a basic Will save, frightened 1 on a failure; half of all it deals heals you. Paid with 30 of your Taint meter.

name: Fan of Knives
description: Cutthroat, level 8: knives fly from you at every enemy within 3 tiles: your weapon's damage against a basic Reflex save, and 1d6 persistent bleed on a failure. 30 Momentum, 6 s cooldown.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Trickster, level 8: a burst of smoke round you: every enemy within 3 tiles that fails a Reflex save is dazzled for 4 s (its blows may miss you), and you vanish into it, hidden for 4 s. 20 Momentum, 15 s cooldown.

name: Deadeye
description: Marksman, level 8: one perfect arrow: three weapon dice more, and it flies on through two enemies behind. 25 Focus, 8 s cooldown. Needs a bow.

name: Call of the Pack
description: Beastmaster, level 8: you howl, and two more wolves run with your pack for 20 s. 25 Focus, 30 s cooldown.

name: Fireball
description: Pyromancer, level 8: a bead of fire bursts on a monster within 10 tiles: 2d6 fire (+1d6 a rank above 1) to everything within 2.5 tiles against a basic Reflex save (your spell DC). 22 Mana, 3 s cooldown.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Stormcaller, level 8: a spell attack for 2d8 electricity (+1d8 a rank above 1) that leaps on to four more enemies. 20 Mana, 4 s cooldown.

name: Raise Bone Knight
description: Bonelord, level 8: a bone knight, twice as tough as a skeleton and armed with a great blade, rises to fight for you (among the skeletons you hold). Two Grave Charges, 20 s cooldown.

name: Plague Cloud
description: Plaguebringer, level 8: a cloud of rot round a monster within 9 tiles: 2d6 acid (+1d6 a rank above 1) to all within 3 tiles of it against a basic Fortitude save (your spell DC), sickened 2 for 6 s on a failure. Two Grave Charges, 8 s cooldown.

name: Sundering Blow
description: A blow that splits armour: a Strike with two weapon dice more, and the target is off-guard for 6 s. 25 Fury, 8 s cooldown. Joins the bar at level 11.

name: Divine Wrath
description: Your god's anger breaks round you: 3d6 fire (+1d6 a rank above 1) to every enemy within 3 tiles against a basic Reflex save (your class DC). 25 Devotion, 10 s cooldown. Joins the bar at level 11.

name: Crippling Strike
description: Cut the tendon: a Strike with two weapon dice more that leaves 1d6 persistent bleed, and the target is slowed for 4 s. 20 Momentum, 6 s cooldown. Joins the bar at level 11.

name: Pinning Shot
description: An arrow through the foot: two weapon dice more, and the target can't move for 3 s. 20 Focus, 8 s cooldown. Needs a bow. Joins the bar at level 11.

name: Cone of Cold
description: A 5-tile cone of killing frost: 3d6 cold (+1d6 a rank above 1) against a basic Reflex save, slowed for 4 s on a failure. 24 Mana, 4 s cooldown. Joins the bar at level 11.

name: Grasp of the Grave
description: Dead hands claw up round a monster within 8 tiles: 3d6 void (+1d6 a rank above 1) to all within 2.5 tiles of it against a basic Reflex save, held fast for 2 s on a failure. A Grave Charge and 12 Mana. Joins the bar at level 11.

name: Earthsplitter
description: Vanguard, level 13: you split the ground in a 4-tile cone: your weapon's damage with two dice more against a basic Reflex save (your class DC), knocked prone for 2 s on a failure. Two-handed only. 35 Fury, 10 s cooldown.

name: Shield Rush
description: Bulwark, level 13: charge up to 7 tiles behind your shield into a Strike with a weapon die more that knocks the target back 2 tiles and prone for 2 s. Needs a shield. 25 Fury, 10 s cooldown.

name: Dawnbreak
description: Lanternbearer, level 13: the lantern bursts like sunrise: 4d6 fire (+1d6 a rank above 1) to all within 4 tiles against a basic Reflex save, and a quarter of all it deals heals you; it hallows the rising dead it covers. 35 Devotion, 15 s cooldown.

name: Ruinous Blow
description: Oathbreaker, level 13: a Strike with three weapon dice more, frightened 2 on a hit. Paid with 25 of your Taint meter. 8 s cooldown.

name: Assassinate
description: Cutthroat, level 13: a killing blow: three weapon dice more, and 2d6 persistent bleed. 35 Momentum, 10 s cooldown.

name: Caltrops
description: Trickster, level 13: scatter caltrops at your feet: the first monster to cross them and all within 2 tiles take 3d6 piercing (+1d6 a rank above 1) against a basic Reflex save, slowed for 6 s on a failure. 20 Momentum.

name: Killshot
description: Marksman, level 13: four weapon dice more, flying on through an enemy behind. 35 Focus, 10 s cooldown. Needs a bow.

name: Hunt as One
description: Beastmaster, level 13: every wolf at your call leaps at the monster you mark, its next bite two dice the stronger. 25 Focus, 10 s cooldown.

name: Meteor
description: Pyromancer, level 13: a burning stone falls on a monster within 10 tiles: 4d6 fire (+1d6 a rank above 1) to everything within 3.5 tiles against a basic Reflex save. 32 Mana, 8 s cooldown.

name: Ball Lightning
description: Stormcaller, level 13: a crackling sphere bursts on a monster within 9 tiles: 4d8 electricity (+1d8 a rank above 1) to all within 2.5 tiles against a basic Reflex save, stunned for a moment on a failure. 30 Mana, 8 s cooldown.

name: Bone Colossus
description: Bonelord, level 13: the graves give up a colossus of fused bone that fights beside you for 25 s. Three Grave Charges, 40 s cooldown.

name: Blight
description: Plaguebringer, level 13: rot blooms round a monster within 9 tiles: 3d6 poison (+1d6 a rank above 1) to all within 3 tiles against a basic Fortitude save, sickened 2 and 1d6 persistent poison on a failure. Two Grave Charges, 8 s cooldown.
